# `cargo cicd workspace doctor`

Diagnoses the Cargo workspace for structural health: duplicate dependencies, missing feature declarations, version skew, and toolchain mismatch. Emits a WorkspaceDoctorEvent.

**Noun:** `workspace` &nbsp;&nbsp; **Verb:** `doctor`

<!-- END ggen:command-reference -->

<!-- BEGIN custom:examples -->
## Examples

```sh
cargo cicd workspace doctor
```
